note: The root key follows the consonants of עֲמָלֵק, the name given in Genesis 36:12.
summary: עֲמָלֵקִי identifies a member of the people of Amalek. Genesis 14:7 uses the singular collectively when it names their territory.

senses.definition: A member of the people of Amalek, or the people collectively.

evidence.note: The singular gentilic in שְׂדֵה הָעֲמָלֵקִי identifies the Amalekites as the people whose territory the kings struck.
Asked who he is, the speaker answers עֲמָלֵקִי אָנֹכִי, “I am an Amalekite.”

senses.gloss: an Amalekite or the Amalekite people
